# GLM-5 & GLM-5.1

## 1 Introduction

!!! note
    
    `The "PD Separation Deployment" mentioned in this document is provided only as an example/reference design to demonstrate the basic process of deploying Prefill and Decode in separated mode. It is not recommended for use in the production environment.
    
    **For the production environment on the customer side, [MindIE Motor](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/en/mindie/latest/quickstart/docs/en/user_guide/quick_start.md) + vLLM-Ascend is recommended.**
    `

GLM-5 model has been discontinued since vLLM Ascend v0.30.0 and will no longer receive support or fixes in subsequent versions. For deployment, please refer to the historical version documentation.

GLM-5.1 uses a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture and targets complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks.

To use the latest features (e.g., PD separation, MTP), use a vLLM-Ascend release that supports GLM-5.1. The version of transformers needs to be 5.2.0 or later.

This document will show the main verification steps of the model, including supported features, feature configuration, environment preparation, single-node and multi-node deployment, accuracy and performance evaluation.

## 2 Supported Features

Refer to supported features to get the model's supported feature matrix.

Refer to feature guide to get the feature's configuration.

## 3 Prerequisites

### 3.1 Model Weight

Weight Version  | Hardware Requirements  | Download Links
--- | --- | ---
`GLM-5.1-w4a8`(Quantized version)  | 1 Atlas 800 A3 (128GB × 8) node or 2 Atlas 800 A2 (64GB × 8) node  | Modelers
`GLM-5.1-w8a8`(Quantized version)  | 1 Atlas 800 A3 (128GB × 8) node or 2 Atlas 800 A2 (64GB × 8) node  | Modelers
`GLM-5.1-w8a8c8-MTP`(Quantized version)  | The weights have been verified on Atlas 800 A3 and are recommended for use.  | Modelers
`GLM-5.1-w4a4c8-mxfp4`(950DT Products mxfp4 Quantized)  | The weights have been verified on 950DT Products and are recommended for use.  | ModelScope

It is recommended to download the model weight to the shared directory of multiple nodes, such as `/root/.cache/`.

> Path description: Download the model weights to a directory of your choice and record it. Ensure the model path in the subsequent deployment command matches this directory.

### 3.2 Verify Multi-node Communication (Optional)

If multi-node deployment is required, please follow the Verify Multi-node Communication Environment guide for communication verification.

Performance tuning notes for single-node:

  * For low-latency scenarios, use `dp1tp16` (data-parallel-size 1, tensor-parallel-size 16) and consider reducing `--max-num-seqs` and `--max-num-batched-tokens`.
  * For high-throughput scenarios, increase `--max-num-seqs` and enable `--enable-prefix-caching`.
  * For long-context scenarios (e.g., 200k), use w4a8 weight (more memory for KV cache) and set `--max-model-len` to the desired context length. Consider enabling `--enable-chunked-prefill`.
  * If you encounter OOM, reduce `--gpu-memory-utilization`, `--max-num-seqs`, or `--max-model-len`. Disabling `"enable_mlapo"` can also reduce memory usage (at the cost of performance).


    --prefill-context-parallel-size 4 \
    --hf-overrides '{"use_index_cache": true, "index_topk_freq": 4}' \
    --seed 1024 \
    --served-model-name glm-5.1 \
    --tool-call-parser glm47 \
    --reasoning-parser glm45 \
    --enable-auto-tool-choice \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 \
    --quantization ascend \
    --enable-chunked-prefill \
    --enable-prefix-caching \
    --async-scheduling \
    --kv-cache-dtype int8 \
    --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype int8 \
    --additional-config '{"enable_balance_scheduling": true, "ascend_compilation_config": {"fuse_muls_add": true}, "enable_flashcomm1": true, "enable_fused_mc2": true, "enable_mlapo": true}' \
    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' \
    --speculative-config '{"num_speculative_tokens": 3, "method": "deepseek_mtp","enforce_eager":true}'
    ```
    
    **Notice:**
    
    - When testing with a prefix cache hit rate > 0, keep `--enable-prefix-caching` (as in the scripts above); when the hit rate is 0, replace it with `--no-enable-prefix-caching`.
    - `"enable_fused_mc2": true` conflicts with `"multistream_overlap_shared_expert": true` — the runtime automatically disables `multistream_overlap_shared_expert` when fused MC2 is enabled.
    `

Required for handling prompts up to 128K tokens.

Decode node-specific configurations:

  * `--additional-config '{"enable_mlapo": true}'`: Enables MLA preprocess operation fusion on decode nodes to significantly improve decode performance. Consumes more NPU memory. In PD scenarios, enable MLAPO only on decode nodes.
  * On decode nodes, size `--max-num-batched-tokens` for both active sequences and MTP speculative tokens, rather than matching it to `--max-num-seqs`. The scripts use a budget of `164` tokens for `32` sequences on A3 and `240` tokens for `60` sequences on 950DT Products, with three speculative tokens per sequence.
  * `--additional-config '{"recompute_scheduler_enable": true}'`: Enables the recomputation scheduler. When decode node KV cache is insufficient, requests are sent back to prefill nodes for KV cache recomputation. In this deployment: `true` on decode nodes; on prefill nodes `true` in the 950DT Products scenario and `false` in the A3 scenario (see the scripts above).

Common PD environment variables:

  * `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:/usr/local/lib`: Required for Mooncake library loading.

MTP in PD scenarios:

  * Prefill nodes use `"num_speculative_tokens": 1` in both scenarios (see the scripts above).
  * Decode nodes use `"num_speculative_tokens": 3` in both scenarios to maximize decode throughput.
  * All prefill and decode nodes must use the same `"method": "deepseek_mtp"` and `"enforce_eager": true`.

For further explanation and restrictions of the environment variables above, refer to: envs.py.

## 6 Functional Verification

Once your server is started, you can query the model with input prompts:
    
    curl http://<node0_ip>:<port>/v1/chat/completions \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d '{
            "model": "glm-5.1",
            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "The future of AI is"}],
            "max_completion_tokens": 15,
            "temperature": 0
        }'

## 9 Performance Tuning

### 9.1 Recommended Configurations

> Note: The following configurations are validated in specific test environments and are for reference only. The optimal configuration depends on factors such as maximum input/output length, prefix cache hit rate, precision requirements, and deployment machine ratios. It is recommended to refer to Tuning Guidelines for tuning based on actual conditions.

The tables below provide recommended parameter configurations for the `GLM-5.1-w8a8c8-MTP` quantized model on Atlas 800 A3, covering three deployment scenarios:

  * Dual-Node Co-Located 198K High Throughput: `DP8 TP1 PCP4`, see Multi-node Deployment.
  * Dual-Node Co-Located 198K Low Latency: `DP2 TP1 PCP16`, see Multi-node Deployment.
  * Prefill-Decode Disaggregation 198K (PP2): prefill `PP2 TP1 PCP16` + decode `DP8 TP4`, see Prefill-Decode Disaggregation (A3 series).
  * Prefill-Decode Disaggregation 198K (950DT Products): prefill `TP1 PCP8` + decode `DP16 TP1`, see Prefill-Decode Disaggregation (950DT Products).

`--max-num-seqs`  | 16 in the reference layout  | 6–64, depending on the layout  | 32–64, subject to KV cache capacity  | Limits concurrent sequences. Tune within the selected parallel layout; sequence counts across different layouts are not directly comparable.

# GLM-5.2 & GLM-5.3

## 1 Introduction

!!! note
    
    The "PD Separation Deployment" mentioned in this document is provided only as an example/reference design to demonstrate the basic process of deploying Prefill and Decode in separated mode. It is not recommended for use in the production environment.
    
    **For the production environment on the customer side, [MindIE Motor](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/en/mindie/latest/quickstart/docs/en/user_guide/quick_start.md) + vLLM-Ascend is recommended.**

GLM-5.2 uses a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture and targets complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks. GLM-5.3 shares its base model with GLM-5.2 but has different post-training. This page covers both models; commands and validation results are version-specific unless explicitly stated otherwise.

This document shows the verification steps for both models, including supported features, environment preparation, single-node and multi-node deployment, PP2 Prefill-Decode disaggregation, MemCache KV pooling, 1M DCP, accuracy, and performance evaluation. 
=== "A3 series"
    
    ##### A3 series {: #glm52-53-5-1-3-a3 }
    
    This A3 reference serves GLM-5.3 W8A8C8 with a **200,000-token** maximum
    sequence length for the 198k workload. It uses one Prefill engine spanning
    P0/P1 with TP16 and PP2, and sixteen TP2 Decode engines on D0/D1.
    Section 5.1.4 adds MemCache KV pooling to the same deployment.
    
    These scripts incorporate the supplied 198k PD+PP configuration; no new
    runtime, accuracy, or performance validation is implied. The 200,000-token
    limit covers the entire sequence, including generated tokens. Use the
    GLM-5.3 W8A8C8 A3 checkpoint; these settings are not a GLM-5.2 validation.
    Local weight/Python paths are placeholders, and API port 8000 and model
    name `glm` are retained for consistency with the launcher and proxy.
    
    The HCCS-only `ASCEND_GLOBAL_RESOURCE_CONFIG` and communication resource
    version `1.2` are retained from the source. Confirm that the target CANN
    stack and inter-node fabric support them before launch; do not apply this
    transport restriction to an unsupported network. Decode retains
    `LOCAL_WORLD_SIZE=16` and OpenMP settings from the source. Check static-kernel
    compatibility with the selected build and TP2 worker layout. Fused MC2 mode
    selection is version-dependent; confirm the effective mode in startup logs.
    
    ###### Topology and Prerequisites
    
    | Role | Nodes | Global DP | TP | PP | Placement | Devices per role |
    | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
    | Prefill | P0, P1 | 1 | 16 | 2 | One PP stage per node | 32 |
    | Decode | D0, D1 | 16 | 2 | 1 | Eight DP ranks per node | 32 |
    
    Each container exposes devices 0-15. P0 exposes the only Prefill API;
    P1 runs the second PP stage without an API server. Decode ranks 0-7 run
    on D0 and ranks 8-15 on D1, with API ports 8000-8007 on each node.

### 7.3 W4A4C8 950DT products Validation Records

Both records below use one 950DT products (96GB × 8), the 2026-10-08 950DT products image, TP8/DP1/EP, eager mode, a configured maximum context of 135000, 16384 batched tokens, 20 sequences and FP8 KV/indexer caches. On 2026-10-10, `/health`, `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/completions` returned HTTP 200 for both local checkpoints. This verifies startup and short requests, not actual 135k inputs, tool use or performance. The historical command used `--reasoning-parser glm45`; the shared commands now use `glm47` to align with GLM-5.3. That parser update has not been revalidated on NPU hardware in this documentation update.

Model / local checkpoint  | Startup and short requests  | Dataset result
--- | --- | ---
GLM-5.2 W4A4C8/MXFP4  | Passed  | No dataset score from this validation
GLM-5.3 W4A4C8/MXFP4, 78 layers, 102 indexed shards  | Passed  | GSM8K: 1279/1319, 96.97%, including 10 request errors

The GLM-5.3 GSM8K run used zero-shot chat, numeric exact match on the content field, `temperature=0`, `seed=42`, `max_tokens=8192`, concurrency 20, a 900-second timeout and no retries. All 1319 samples were attempted; 1309 requests finished normally and 10 failed. The score includes those 10 errors in the denominator. It is a local-checkpoint result, not GPQA or an AISBench benchmark result, and does not establish a throughput gate. The local checkpoint was not matched to a public release revision or verified by per-shard hashes.

### Description

We observed accuracy fluctuations when serving `GLM-5.2-W4A8C8` with Prefill-Decode (PD) disaggregation and enabling Sparse Flash Attention C8:
    
    --additional-config '{"enable_sparse_sfa_c8": true}'

When GPQA is evaluated repeatedly with the same model, dataset, and decoding configuration, the accuracy fluctuates by approximately 2–3 percentage points.

GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 should currently be considered experimental. Although it reduces memory usage, its accuracy stability may not match GLM-5.2-W8A8C8, particularly in PD deployments with enable_sparse_sfa_c8 enabled.
